prompt: The most important aim of science should be to improve people's lives. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement
essay:
The most fundamental goal of Science should be to improve people’s well-being. I strongly agree with this view because Science can improve the quality of human life in various dimensions, such as the medical aspect , and increase financial income, which supports the economic aspect of people’s lives.

The primary reason why I agree with this view is that science significantly enhances the quality of human life in many dimensions. This is because the remarkable evolution in research studies has supported and improved the healthcare system and healthy lifestyle. Moreover, medical research has established a healthy diet routine for diabetic and obese patients.

For example, diabetic patients should follow a diet with low levels of sugar

According to what was recommended in the last studies in 2025. As a result

, There is a substantial effect of medical science on individual lives.

Furthermore, I also agree with this statement related to an increase in financial income and growth in economic rewards. In other words, researchers’ profits will grow when they have published an article in a global journal. For example, many universities have allocated 20 per cent of their budgets to fund scientific research from the Google Scholar website and the PubMed database. Therefore, economic development is indirectly affected by the publication of scientific papers in academic journals.

In conclusion, Science dramatically plays a crucial role in individuals’ health outcomes and economic development through enhancing healthy lifestyles and increasing financial rewards. Overall, the quality of life can greatly improve according to the scientific theories to lead more healthy and productive lives.
